pergunta: What is the per-node inclusion probability p_i^te = P(i in V_te(sigma)) and p_i^va, and the version conditional on the block of i being drawn as test, p_i|te = P(i retained | block(i) in test)? Does the empirical profile by distance to the edge and by class k(i) (number of lateral neighboring blocks within b=2km) reproduce the hypergeometric closed form (k_te-1)_k/(N-1)_k?
alegacao: formal estimand of the article (D6-i): basis for 2.3 and for the definition paragraph in Sec.3
hipotese: under uniform sampling without replacement of the blocks (70/15/15) with buffer trimming b=2km, the nodal retention conditional on the block being test follows the hypergeometric law of the neighbours that must also be test for the node not to be trimmed; the mean of p_i|te over the nodes of test blocks reproduces the nodal reference of test 1.8 (200 seeds, 0.449-0.453)
metodo_fixado: 4 cells (bauru,campinas,lins,sorocaba Q1, g10b2, N=132 blocks, k_te=20 test blocks — reconstruction identical to 1.8 via build_synthetic_grid+assign_groups+split split_espacial_3vias, exact cKDTree); 100 random seeds RandomState(20260927).randint(1e6,size=100); per node: int32 counters of retention in test and in validation, and a counter of how many times the node's block was drawn as test (never keep persistent masks; only counters). Class k(i) = sum of 4 indicators (dx<b, g-dx<b, dy<b, g-dy<b) restricted to the existence of a neighbouring block in that direction (looking up the id of the neighbouring block in the set of existing blocks). Distance to border = min(dx,g-dx,dy,g-dy) in km, bins of 0.25 km from 0 to 5 km.
forma_fechada: P(k specified neighbours of i all test | block of i test) = perm(k_te-1,k)/perm(N-1,k) (falling factorial, hypergeometric); p_i^te = (k_te/N) x p_i|te (exact identity since P(block of i test)=k_te/N is deterministic at each split draw)
limiar_aceitacao: mean of p_i|te over the nodes of test blocks reproduces the nodal retention of 1.8 (0.449-0.453) to <0.5% relative; the empirical profile per class k(i) stays within <2% absolute (not relative) of the closed form at k=0,1,2
refutacao: if the mean of p_i|te falls outside [0.449,0.453]*(1+-0.005) OR if |empirico(k)-forma_fechada(k)| >= 0.02 (2 absolute percentage points) at k=0, 1 or 2 in any of the 4 cells, the hypergeometric formalism is declared insufficient and the estimand definition (2.3) cannot rely on it without a note
